input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $18.75 on order DD-48230, dated 2026-11-04. The deduction was applied with the reason "missing item", citing a Green Smoothie. The order ticket for DD-48230 lists the Green Smoothie, which shows the item was part of the order as placed [DD-48230:ticket_lists_item]. The ticket does not by itself show how the order was packed, and we are not claiming that it does. Our records also show the order was ready at 13:24 and was picked up at 13:29, five minutes later, so the handoff to the courier took place after the order was ready [DD-48230:pickup_handoff]. Based on this record, we ask that the deduction be reviewed and, if appropriate, reversed. We are happy to provide any further information that would help with the review.
